scope: I reviewed exact selected power, analog and control capacitors using public manufacturer data. This report distinguishes nominal component evidence from unproven effective capacitance.
overall_status: Fourteen numeric-minimum supply/reference banks remain open, plus two complete isolated-port capacitance/startup gates and the separate parent hold-up gate. No evidence acquired in this review closes their worst-case DC-bias/aging/temperature or complete converter-startup bounds.

source_documents.basis: Page1 exact2.2uF,100V,X7R,1210,+/-10%; capacitance test1+/-0.2Vrms,1kHz,+/-10%,25C after preheat/de-aging conditioning. PDF provides no capacitance-versus-DC-bias curve; warnings say changes with voltage, temperature and time must be considered.

Primary exact product page confirms680uF,25V,+/-20%,D10xH16P5mm; categorytemperature-40to105C is not a capacitance-temperature guarantee.
Primary indexed model list identifiesGRM21BR71H105KA12 as1uF50VX7R0805+/-10%; exact suffixL and bias performance still need approval data.

Exact full part selected in Murata SimSurfing; CSV electrical model excludes packing suffix L. Six manufacturer exports retain source headers and individual hashes. The two temperature curves each have 101 samples from 0 to 50 C at 0.5 C steps, 1 kHz and 0.01 Vrms. Typical sampled range is 5.682853749850013 to 6.660150072139644 uF at 5.25 V DC, and 6.168479735819904 to 7.552852405380563 uF at 3.4 V DC; both minima occur at 0 C. These are model data, not guaranteed production minima or physical measurements, and do not establish aging, tolerance or behavior between samples. Other exact-part export attempts stalled; no substitute curve is used.

calculation_policy.aging_caveat: The5% factor is an explicitly chosen screening allowance, not a verified manufacturer aging guarantee or lifetime contract. Listed required-retention factors are finite closure criteria, not passed results.
calculation_policy.bias_caveat: Capacitance at zero bias or nominal dielectric/voltage rating does not establish capacitance at operating bias; separate voltage and temperature effects may interact.

isolated_port_capacitance_gates.closure: Run and archive the current TI calculator with 5 V nominal VINP, 5 V selected output and a 180 mA port budget, then evaluate actual VINP including input-bead/source drop, output regulation, 0–50 °C, tolerance, DC bias and explicit time/aging conditions. parent_hold_up.basis: FR-A permits25% change from initial after endurance; a680uF initial-low unit could be408uF at20C after that test. Therefore500uF is not guaranteed throughout the advertised endurance solely by the family table.
parent_hold_up.closure: Before capture approval, decide whether the500uF criterion is initial-prototype only or a defined service-life requirement. Obtain exact Panasonic capacitance-temperature/time evidence or qualify measured500uF minimum with the intended replacement interval. If that cannot be met, I revise the hold-up part/count or bleeder/disable contract and rerun the calculation; this report makes no independent substitution.

other_selected_capacitors.closure: Obtain exact approved manufacturer bias/temperature/time evidence. The two added VDD bypasses add2uF nominal /2.53uF positive-tolerance-and-temperature screen to the parent startup account, do not alter12.7765uF child-output maxima, and provide no credited minimum hold-up while their effective capacitance is unverified.
For dVdT timing, derive the waveform from exact low-bias capacitance and time/temperature bounds; nominal bypass capacitance alone does not close startup timing.
Confirm exact active ordering suffix and approved manufacturer data. Check effective local capacitance at3.4V against the STM32 hardware guide; no curve-based guarantee is claimed.

finite_completion_steps: I freeze the effective minimum, maximum, ESR and measurement conditions listed per bank.
I obtain exact manufacturer performance/approval data, retaining its source and revision.
I evaluate the exact curves at the operating bias and 0–50 C with initial tolerance and an explicit time/aging contract, saving the raw evidence and calculation.
I distinguish typical-curve screening from production guarantees and measure representative ordered capacitors at actual bias and temperature before approving layout.
If a bank fails, I revise its selected part/count within regulator capacitance/ESR limits and repeat startup/hold-up calculations.
